approval_scope: The preregistration and numerical thresholds were approved before the repeat packet was opened. Before any case was exposed, the reviewer removed the waiting period and directed immediate opening; the amendment changes no instrument, population, measure, or threshold.
title: Scout relevance within-reviewer repeatability
purpose: Measure whether the same reviewer reproduces the complete relevance decision chain under a frozen schema. This is not an accuracy, inter-reviewer, generalization, account-relevance, agent-accuracy, or annotation-causality study.

population.digest_method: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing the sorted evaluation_id list and n; no production text or identity fields

baseline.eligibility_basis: The recorded packet used the same exclusion-first chain and the in_post/pointer/none content-sufficiency distinction over all 79 cases. The reviewer clarified before the repeat packet was opened that 'reply you would post' meant enough substantive reply material for the study's agent-work scope, not personal expertise, willingness, or account preference. The clarification changes no baseline label.

comparison.actual_interval_rule: No interval analysis is required. Acknowledge in interpretation that the immediate repeat may retain memory effects.
comparison.randomization: Sort all 79 evaluation_ids by SHA-256(seed + ':display:' + decimal evaluation_id), assign opaque case_id values 1..79 after sorting, and expose neither evaluation_id nor seed-derived metadata in the interface.

primary.name: exact agreement on complete decision chain
primary.representation: excluded cases are excluded:<category>; non-excluded cases are exclusion:none|substance:<in_post|pointer|none>

secondary.name: substance agreement
secondary.denominator: cases with exclusion=none in both sittings

secondary.name: cases entering or leaving the substance question
label distributions and complete transition tables

missing_data.unasked_substance: Store null and exclude it from the substance denominator; never encode it as substance=none.
missing_data.missing_label: The interface rejects incomplete submission. No case is removed; no primary result is reported until all 79 complete chains exist.
missing_data.ungradable_display: A corrupted or unavailable case invalidates the sitting; repair and restart that sitting under the same frozen instrument. Ordinary ambiguity is graded with the closest allowed label and may receive a private note.
missing_data.instrument_defect: Version the instrument and restart the comparison; never pool definitions.

decision_thresholds.rationale: A 90% practical floor allows at most about one unstable judgment in ten. The five-case indeterminate band separates that operational target from clearly material instability without presenting a sampling p-value for this fixed, previously studied census.

secondary_diagnostics.substance_among_both_clear: flag below 90% with numerator and denominator reported

analysis_order: Compute and record all preregistered measures without reading notes.
Then inspect private disagreement notes as exploratory ambiguity analysis.
Compare earlier results only when question and denominator are genuinely comparable.
uncertainty: No uncertainty interval is primary. This is a fixed census of 79 previously studied cases, so a binomial interval would describe hypothetical repeated cases rather than generalization to fresh cases.

visible: parent text under the frozen context policy
blinding.notes: Optional and private; never used to revise the instrument mid-sitting.

publication_boundary: After grading, derive only allowlisted labels and derived values keyed by evaluation_id, aggregates and evidence status, the frozen preregistration, Assay implementation commit/path, safe digests, and SHA-256 checksums excluding the checksum file. Exclude text, authors, handles, URLs, notes, private keys, and private receipt locations.
